headline: Profit recovers sharply, helped by one-off compensation
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 834.8B (-4.6% y/y, +22.9% q/q) and operating profit KRW 82.1B (+23.2% y/y); EPS was KRW 477, up 15.2% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of KRW 477 rose 190.8% q/q and 15.2% y/y. Reports of the filing put revenue at KRW 834.8B and operating profit at KRW 82.1B, a margin near 9.8% versus 7.6% a year earlier. Net profit was roughly flat y/y at about KRW 46.4B. Brokers flag one-off customer compensation in the figures. Drivers and guidance are not assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Revenue and operating profit come from Korean news reports of the filing. Brokers say one-off compensation for customer volume shortfalls inflates the quarter. EPS is Yahoo data.
